Check the inputs of fit_survival_model()

dot-check_survival_model_args.Rd

Shared by the data.frame and tbl_dbi methods, so the checks cannot drift apart. Stops with an error if panel is not a survival_panel, if a covariate is not one of its columns, if band_width is not a single positive number, or if ... holds an argument of fixest::fepois() that fit_survival_model() sets itself or that would be wrong on summed cells (weights, cluster). Runs before the cells are summed, so a database panel is not queried for a call that would fail.

Usage

.check_survival_model_args(panel, covariate_cols, band_width, dot_names = NULL)

Arguments

panel

The panel argument of fit_survival_model().

covariate_cols

Character vector. The covariates to model.

band_width

Number. The width of the tenure bands, in years.

dot_names

Character vector or NULL. The names of the arguments in fit_survival_model()'s ..., from ...names().

Value

NULL, invisibly.
